capability_semantics: Availability describes existing source semantics, not installed instrumentation or runtime qualification.
publication_projection: Only C successful ready-frame CAS can project producer.published; failure heads, invalidation, stale CAS, derived refresh and A in-place completion cannot.
clock_policy: Same clock for durations; CPU requires same process/TID/start. No cross-origin subtraction. Navigation/restart requires a new stream/clock. Sequence gaps remain failures, not inferred events.
identity_policy: Caller-exposed scalars only. No new reads/serialization/telemetry advancement. Null requires an unavailable reason. No timestamp/numeric-equality identity synthesis.
v1_policy: Immutable collector schema/analyzer; compatible projections only, sidecar analyzed separately. Non-boundary v1 records remain in their original stream.
capture_policy: Conditional adapter only; TLS/H2/unsupported encoding unavailable. No root/broad capture, compression changes, interception or silent transport fallback.
